title: Uwell Viscore Lemon & Lime Pod & Refill - 20mg
description: The Uwell Viscore Prefilled Pod & Refill in Lemon & Lime delivers a classic citrus flavour, blending the tangy zest of lemons with the vibrant kick of limes. Designed for the Uwell Viscore 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit, this pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and a 10ml refill container for long-lasting value and convenience. Equipped with a 0.8ohm mesh coil, the pod provides a smooth, flavour-rich vape and consistent vapour production, making it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. The refill container makes it easy to extend the pod’s lifespan, offering up to 8000 puffs, depending on personal usage. Preloaded with 20mg/ml nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod delivers a silky-smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine absorption, perfect for adult vapers seeking a high-quality and satisfying vaping experience. Replace the pod and refill container when empty to continue enjoying the bright, zesty Lemon & Lime flavour.
